.. change::
    :tags: feature, postgresql

    Added PostgreSQL 18 row level security schema objects and typed DDL elements
    for policy creation and removal together with table enable and force
    state. Added
    :meth:`_postgresql.PGInspector.get_row_security` to reflect table flags and
    complete policy definitions. Added
    :meth:`_postgresql.PGInspector.get_multi_row_security` for bulk reflection.
